args.summary: Breaking schema change in landing/bureau/meridian_refresh_20261102.csv: the header is borrower_id,fico_score,score_date. Contract meridian_weekly_refresh v1.3 requires the column "score", which is now delivered as "fico_score". This is a column rename, which the contract treats as a breaking change. It needs 30 days' notice to data-platform@harborlending.example. The notice was posted 2026-10-28, only 6 days before the change took effect. Our ingest_bureau task for ds=2026-11-02 failed (SchemaMismatchError, 3 attempts). That blocks dbt_build and publish, so mart_delinquency is stuck at 2026-10-30. Action needed: please re-deliver the 2026-11-02 refresh using the contracted v1.3 header (score) as meridian_refresh_20261102_r1.csv. If you want to make the rename permanent, agree a contract version update with the 30-day notice period. Once the corrected file arrives we will reprocess the partition.

args.summary: Meridian renamed the column score to fico_score in the 2026-11-02 bureau refresh. The contract counts a rename as a breaking change and requires 30 days' notice. They gave 6 days (announced 2026-10-28). Because of the rename, ingest_bureau failed, which blocked dbt_build and publish. That is why raw.bureau and mart_delinquency are stale. All four alerts come from this one cause. Nothing wrong was loaded, so there is nothing to quarantine. The runbook says not to change the pipeline to absorb this. Once the corrected file arrives, the 2026-11-02 partition needs to be reprocessed.
